title: VS-103 — Brand Brain V2 and Brand Intelligence Topic Graph

notes: Upgrades Brand intelligence using evidence already captured by the shared Source Intelligence pipeline.
Adds deterministic versioned Topic Graph intelligence and lineage for Hunter without changing Hunter ranking in this slice.
Sector packs are configurable low-precedence seeds and cannot override confirmed Brand facts or exclusions.
No frozen UI, new retrieval pipeline, OAuth scope, scheduler or autonomous publishing change is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner explicitly instructed Go 5, authorizing Batch 5 Brand Brain V2, Brand Intelligence Topic Graph and sector-pack scope.
Reuses existing provenance, untrusted-source, deletion, tenant-isolation and human-publishing decisions; sector packs are seeds rather than truth.
Requires deterministic verification and exact-SHA Product Owner approval.
Release remains a separate authorization gate.
Production enablement remains a separate authorization gate.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: Confirmed and inferred Brand evidence produces a deterministic, provenance-aware Topic Graph that improves later Hunter query/ranking without a second ingestion pipeline.
